description: Defines internal APIs, data structures, and constants for Bluetooth Audio Endpoint handling in Zephyr OS, including unicast and broadcast stream management.

methods.name: bt_bap_ep_state_str
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the Bluetooth Audio Endpoint state.

methods.name: bt_bap_ep_is_broadcast_snk
methods.description: Checks if the endpoint is a broadcast sink.

methods.name: bt_bap_ep_is_broadcast_src
methods.description: Checks if the endpoint is a broadcast source.

methods.name: bt_bap_ep_is_unicast_client
methods.description: Checks if the endpoint is a unicast client.
